ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)

   D. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.

   B. Hiding stolen items
